slides.title: Is this [[you]]?
items: It's dark by 5 and feels like 9
You're sleepy too early, then not

slides.title: Your clock [[shifted]]
slides.body: When the clocks move an hour, your body doesn't switch overnight. Meals, wake-up time and bedtime can feel a little off for a few days.
slides.speech: Give it a few days, okay~

slides.title: Dark [[comes early]]
slides.body: With sunset before dinner, long evenings under bright lights and screens can blur the line between day and night. Evenings lose their rhythm.

items.head: Keep dinner on schedule
items.sub: Same time daily, even if it's dark

items.head: Dim the lights after 9
items.sub: Switch to a soft, warm lamp

slides.title: Evening [[checklist]]
slides.note: Lifestyle tips only. If it lasts, talk to a professional.

slides.title: Cozy nights with [[Calm]]~
slides.body: Save, share and tell a friend

caption:
Dark by 5 and your evening feels off? 🌙

When the clocks go back, your daily rhythm needs a few days to catch up, and early sunsets blur the line between day and night.
Try three small habits starting tonight:
Keep dinner on schedule · Dim the lights after 9 · Set a phone-down time
